title: The invite
caption: Priya wants to share Waypoint with her cousin. One code, and both get ten points. The founder tells her story.
linkedin_text: A friend invite that is personal instead of loud. On Waypoint, My Waypoints shows your invite code and a button to share the link. A new member can enter it in their first seven days, and both people get ten points.

cast.priya: Priya, a young Indian woman in her early twenties with a long braid, a denim jacket and a small backpack

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a black-and-white floral shirt and khaki shorts, facing the camera on a sunny cafe terrace in the afternoon, a relaxed smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Priya's story. She found something on Waypoint that she wants to share.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Priya's story. She found something on Waypoint that she wants to share.
scenes.title: The invite

scenes.clip: {priya} sitting on a college lawn with her phone and a paper cup of chai, a soft smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Her cousin Kabir has had a heavy month. She wants to hand him a quiet place, not give advice.
scenes.sub: Her cousin Kabir has had a heavy month. She wants to hand him a quiet place, not give advice.

scenes.clip: {priya} walking along a tree-lined campus path looking at her phone, soft afternoon light, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: In My Waypoints she finds her own invite code, and a button to share the invite link.
scenes.sub: In My Waypoints she finds her own invite code, and a button to share the invite link.

scenes.clip: {priya} typing a message on her phone on a garden bench, a warm smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: She sends it to Kabir herself, with one kind line.
scenes.sub: She sends it to Kabir herself, with one kind line.

scenes.clip: {priya} looking up from her phone with a pleased surprise, trees behind her, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Kabir has his first seven days on Waypoint to enter the code.
scenes.sub: Kabir has his first seven days on Waypoint to enter the code.

scenes.clip: {priya} laughing quietly at her phone in a sunlit garden, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: When he does, both of them get ten points.
scenes.sub: When he does, both of them get ten points.
